findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, subject to payment of fees for Services properly performed through the effective termination date. Contractor may terminate only for Client's material breach under Section 12.1.
Invoices are payable Net 40. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 1.0% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law.

Client may terminate for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, subject to payment of fees for Services properly performed through the effective termination date. Contractor may terminate only for Client's material breach under Section 12.1.
findings.explanation: You can be ended by the client at any time with 20 days’ notice, but you will be paid for work already done; the client cannot be terminated for convenience.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, and the terminating party shall pay the other party all fees for Services performed up to the effective termination date.

findings.suggested_change: Invoices are payable Net 30. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 1.0% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law.
